nodes.label: Explainer Video Stage (explainer.html)
nodes.rationale: Screen-recorded rather than exported from an editor: a fixed 1920x1080 stage scaled to fill the window, with all timing expressed as animation-delay on one shared timeline, so changing a scene means changing two numbers. R restarts, F fullscreens, space pauses.

nodes.label: Two Aspect Ratios From One File
nodes.rationale: The wide cut for the channel and Facebook and the vertical cut for stories come from the same document via ?v=story or the V key, because two separate files would diverge at the first edit.

nodes.label: Nine-Scene Explainer Sequence
nodes.rationale: The daily question, the cost of the late answer (an hour, a litre, a stale post), the information already existing with the station owner but having no road to the people, one tap building that road, delivery to whoever chose their city and fuel, wholly free, an invitation addressed to both owner and user, the name and slogan, and the QR codes filmed straight off the screen.

nodes.label: QR Legibility Under Video Compression
nodes.rationale: Codes are drawn at 340px inside a 1920 frame so the densest 53-module code still lands about 3.4 pixels per module when watched at 1080 wide on a phone; 270px would drop it to 2.5 and make it a gamble on video compression. The code itself is inked rather than green because green on white is about 3.9:1 contrast, enough on paper but not necessarily after compression and broadcast colour shift.

nodes.label: Persistent Brand Band
nodes.rationale: Scenes end at the edge of the bottom band rather than running under it: making the mark opaque above the content hid the overlap instead of preventing it, and a phone edge disappearing behind a card reads as a design mistake. The band is part of the layout and each scene centres in what is left above it.
